verdict.rationale: gstack's docs say each supported agent (Claude, Codex, Factory, Kiro, OpenCode, Slate, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, GBrain) is defined as a typed host config, and that adding a new host is a single-file change. A per-host doc exists for OpenClaw, and there is a Claude Code dev-mode install path, so installing one collection across multiple agents is clearly a designed capability. Missing for 10: explicit step-by-step install instructions for each harness (Codex and Cursor setup steps are not shown), and independent or hands-on confirmation of installs outside Claude Code.
